production.note: PROVISIONAL (databases). US model year 2004 only. Edmunds and KBB list a 2004 R32; KBB's R32 page offers only the years "2008" and "2004" (kbb-r32-years), the 2008 car being the Mk5. Volkswagen of America's 2007 release on the Mk5 says "First introduced in 2004 to an enthusiastic reception, the R32 ..." (vw-us-2007-r32-release). Sold in the US simply as the 'R32'.

displacementL.note: Edmunds 'Engine Size 3.2 L'; MotorWeek '3.2-Liter'. No opened page gave the cc figure.

aspiration.note: No forced induction is mentioned; inferred.

drivetrain.note: Edmunds 'Drive Type All wheel drive'; KBB 'AWD' (4Motion).

transmission.note: Edmunds 'Transmission 6-speed manual'; MotorWeek: 'a 6-speed manual with a hydraulic clutch'. The DSG gearbox was not offered on the US 2004 car per these listings.

powerHp.note: PROVISIONAL (databases, with one publication agreeing). Quote (KBB 2004 R32 Hatchback 2D): "Horsepower 240 @ 6250 RPM". Edmunds 2004 R32: "Horsepower 240 hp @ 6,250 rpm" (edmunds-2004-r32); MotorWeek's 2004 Golf R32 road test spec line: 'Horsepower 240' (motorweek-2004-r32).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL (database). 2004 R32, 6-speed manual (the only transmission). Quote (KBB): "Curb Weight 3409 pounds". Edmunds: "Curb Weight 3,409 lbs." (edmunds-2004-r32); iSeeCars 'AWD 2dr Hatchback': 'Curb Weight | 3409 | lbs' (iseecars-2004-r32). The three databases agree exactly and very likely share one data feed, so they count as one source.

sources.publisher: Volkswagen of America (release reproduced by The Auto Channel)
sources.title: 2007 Chicago Auto Show: Hot VW R 3.2 L Heats It Up

provisionalNote: Power (240 hp) rests on KBB and Edmunds, with MotorWeek's unsigned road-test spec line agreeing; weight (3,409 lb) rests on KBB, Edmunds and iSeeCars, which probably share one data feed (effectively one source); the single model year and the body, drivetrain and transmission rest on Edmunds and KBB. A Volkswagen of America press kit or spec sheet for the 2004 R32, or a major magazine specification panel, would replace them.
